objects.taxonomy_description: Time-telling device designed for wall mounting with a circular face 20-40 cm in diameter. Face features hour numerals (Arabic, Roman, or markers) arranged in a 12-hour circle. Two or three hands (hour, minute, second) rotate from the center. Frame is wood, metal, or plastic in various finishes (oak, black, white, brass). Mounting bracket or keyhole slot on the back. Quartz movement powered by a single AA battery. Glass or plastic crystal covers the face. Some models have a pendulum visible below the face. Overall depth is 5-10 cm.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Time-telling device designed for wall mounting with a circular face of moderate diameter, easily readable from across a room.
Face features hour numerals arranged in a 12-hour circle.
Overall depth is slim and unobtrusive.
Functional_Components: Two or three hands rotate from the center.
Mounting bracket or keyhole slot on the back.
Some models have a pendulum visible below the face.
Material_and_Context: Frame is wood, metal, or plastic in various finishes.
Quartz movement powered by a single AA battery.
Glass or plastic crystal covers the face.

objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Omnivorous with highly developed olfactory sense.

Head_and_Face: Large head with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting.
Large floppy or erect ears depending on breed.
Body_and_Plumage: Stocky barrel-shaped body with variable size ranging from moderate to impressively massive.
Sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Short stout legs with cloven hooves.
